title: Stage 4 Layer Report
description: Quality report returned by a single Quality Gate subagent layer.

layer.description: Which Quality Gate layer produced this report.

result.description: Overall result for this layer. FAIL if any critical issues remain unfixed.

critical.description: Issues that must be fixed before publish.

moderate.description: Issues that should be fixed but won't block publish.

low.description: Minor suggestions (flag for Gen, not auto-fixed).

fixes_applied.description: Fixes already applied by the subagent during its Phase 2 pass.

id.description: References the issue id this fix addresses.

description.description: Human-readable description of what was changed.

before.description: Original text snippet before the fix.

after.description: Replacement text snippet after the fix.

keywordDensity.description: [seo-audit] Primary keyword density as a decimal (e.g. 0.015 = 1.5%).

bannedWordsFound.description: [anti-ai] List of banned words/phrases found in the draft.

actualWordCount.description: [voice] Word count measured during voice layer review.

wordCountTarget.description: [voice] Expected word count range for this category.

id.description: Unique issue identifier within this layer report (e.g. 'fc-001', 'seo-003').

claim.description: The specific text or claim in the draft being flagged.
